name: Wing Assistant
summary: Managed virtual assistants for founders and teams: delegate admin, inbox, scheduling and repetitive tasks to a dedicated, trained assistant.
best_for: founders drowning in delegatable admin who have processes to hand off and want a managed VA without recruiting one themselves
skip_if: your workflows live only in your head — document or automate the repetitive work first, before paying a human to run undefined chaos
honest_knock: You're renting a person, not automating a task — a good VA is real leverage, but only if you already have documented, delegatable work. Hand over chaos and you'll get chaos back, faster.

pricing.entry_price_terms: General Virtual Assistant, part-time · per month as published
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and again on 2026-09-28 against Wing's homepage plan cards and its machine-readable llms.txt; wingassistant.com/pricing/ itself now redirects to a call-booking page) This is a managed assistant service, not software. General Virtual Assistant part-time is $699 a month for 80 hours and full-time $999 a month for 160 hours, which Wing presents as a 16% saving against the part-time rate pro-rated. The llms.txt also lists two premium plans with published rates — Executive Assistant $1,299 a month and Super Assistant $4,999 a month, both 160 hours, the latter Asia-based — while other specialist roles and enterprise remain quoted. The published package includes a dedicated assistant, a success manager and free replacement if the fit is wrong. Since September 2026 Wing also sells Wing Teams: ten purpose-built groups of assistants bundled around one business function — web and growth, bookkeeping and AP/AR, admin, sales, marketing, lead generation, answering service, medical billing, SEO and social. None of the ten carries a published rate: the teams page offers only "Free quote. No long-term contract.", so a team is a quoted engagement and cannot be compared against the $699 and $999 figures above (wingassistant.com/teams/, read 22 September and 28 September 2026).

compare_with.name: MyOutDesk or a direct hire
